name: com.lingkyn.audio.unity
description: ScriptableObject binding of bus, parameter, and snapshot identity to an AudioMixer, its exposed parameters, and its snapshots, with fail-closed binding validation and stable codes, a mixer surface seam, and a plain runtime constructed with explicit references that applies accepted parameter values in order, transitions snapshots with an explicit duration, and reports every by-name resolution failure, for the Lingkyn Audio Core.
